name: gmail-email-triage
description: Machine-readable definition of the triage flow implemented in src/Code.gs. scripts/check-flows.js verifies that every function named here exists in the code and that every limit equals the value in the code.

triggers.note: same logic as processNewEmails, with per-message logging

max_attempts.meaning: failed attempts before a message is parked as GAVE_UP

lookback_hours.meaning: never look further back than this

max_list_pages.meaning: pages of 100 inbox messages considered per run

time_budget_ms.meaning: stop starting new messages after this

steps.does: Take the script lock (waits up to 10 s). If another run holds it, skip this run.
Read API key, model ID and spreadsheet ID from Script Properties; record the processing start time on first run.
Create or validate the 13-column results tab; create the _triage_state tab (ensureStateSheet_).
List inbox messages received after the start time (query: in:inbox after:<epoch> plus optional sender allowlist), oldest first.
Skip messages whose state is DONE or GAVE_UP.
If a results row already exists for the message ID, only re-apply the six labels from that row. No new row, no Claude call.
Read sender, subject, received time and plain-text body (HTML fallback) with the Gmail API.
If an allowlist is set and the sender is not on it, skip the message without recording state.
Build the request (buildRequest_), call Claude (callClaude_), extract the record_triage tool input (extractDecision_) and validate it (validateDecision_). One extra attempt if the output is invalid.
Assemble the 13 columns; build column K with buildColumnK_ (action, then draft only when a reply is the right immediate action); apply the escalation rule (applyEscalationRule_).
Set the row to plain text, then write exactly one row for the message ID.
Create missing Triage/... labels and add the six labels to that message only.
Mark the message DONE. Failures mark RETRY or GAVE_UP with the error text.

message_states.RETRY: Failed with a permanent per-message error; will be tried again next run
message_states.GAVE_UP: Failed MAX_ATTEMPTS times; parked until resetFailedMessages is run
message_states.DONE: Row written and six labels applied

error_policy.effect: Retry inside the call (short backoff). If still failing, stop the batch; nothing is marked processed and attempts are not consumed.

error_policy.condition: HTTP 400, 401, 403, 404 from the Claude API, or missing Script Properties
error_policy.effect: Stop the run and raise an error (visible in Executions); attempts are not consumed.

error_policy.condition: Invalid, cut-off or missing tool output after one extra attempt
error_policy.effect: No row written; attempts + 1; RETRY, or GAVE_UP at the limit.

error_policy.condition: Gmail read or label failure for one message
error_policy.effect: attempts + 1; if the row was already written, the next run only recovers the labels.

error_policy.condition: Another run holds the script lock
